title: Pedal layout and brake hold convenience
summary: Feedback in this topic combines praise for brake-hold convenience with a specific complaint about pedal positioning and operation, while many other mentions are descriptive or instructional rather than clearly evaluative.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the ability to take a foot off the brake when stopped and resume driving with a light accelerator input.

negative.summary: Negative feedback describes the pedal angle and layout as uncomfortable and difficult to operate, including foot and ankle strain and possible contact with both pedals.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined mentions mostly describe how brake-hold or foot-motion features work or give usage instructions without a clear positive or negative judgment, with one example noting possible contact with both pedals but not enough sentiment context.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear evaluative evidence is limited.
This topic mixes pedal/brake comments with foot-motion instructions for another feature, reducing topic coherence.
Some negative-sounding details appear only in undetermined fragments, so sentiment context is incomplete for those examples.
